# DuckDB Report Studio

> A local Wails desktop workbench for reproducible DuckDB SQL analysis and Quarto report delivery.

## Primary documentation

- [README](README.md)
- [Installation and runtime requirements](docs/INSTALL.md)
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Architecture

- Go 1.26 backend and Wails 2.13 desktop shell.
- Vue 3 and TypeScript frontend.
- Embedded DuckDB 2.0 database driver.
- Quarto 1.8 for QMD reports.
- Workflow model: data source or SQL or report or export presets connected as ordered steps.

## Entry points

- `main.go`: Wails application bootstrap.
- `app.go`: desktop API boundary and workspace lifecycle.
- `internal/cli`: headless command tree shared with the desktop backend.
- `internal/runner`: workflow execution.
- `internal/database`: DuckDB access and import.
- `internal/report`: Quarto rendering and report table generation.
- `frontend/src/App.vue`: workbench UI.

## Runtime notes

- Basic SQL analysis needs no external database server.
- Python QMD reports require Jupyter, pandas, matplotlib, and duckdb.
- R QMD reports require DBI, duckdb, dplyr, ggplot2, knitr, scales, and rmarkdown.
- PDF reports use Quarto Typst output.
- `duckdb-report-cli` exposes status, doctor, query, import, render, and workflow commands
  with JSON output for agents and automation.
- `doctor` audits workflow wiring, SQL syntax, QMD placeholders/assets, and runtime
  dependencies without modifying files.
- Companion agent skill:
  https://github.com/alexwoo79/skills_plugins/tree/main/codex-skills/duckdb-sql-analytics
